parts.text: R uth’s Marriage is a marriage counseling and coaching company focused on helping couples enjoy their marriage God’s way.
We believe that God’s purpose for marriage is good and also to make us better people, therefore most marriages can thrive with the right knowledge and support.

We also understand that the success of a marriage is equally dependent on who we marry, so we do not only focus on the married; we coach and guide singles on how to date purposefully and make wise marital decisions.
Our mission is to spread the gospel of a happy and thriving marriage, which eventually helps everyone to have a better society as the family is the smallest unit in a society.

At Ruth’s Marriage, we provide various specialized marriage therapy, couples counseling, premarital counseling, and relationship clarity services to individuals, singles, and couples. We also have tailor-made resources that help couples and individuals “do the work” without having to sit in front of
Ruth’s Marriage is located in Lagos, Nigeria, and operates virtually, serving couples and singles from all over the world.
We love and relate with empathy towards all people.
Our services are client-focused and tailored to meet individual needs and our employees are trained to meet and exceed our client expectations.
Our employees carry themselves professionally, convey a good attitude, and communicate with our clients and their coworkers in a professional manner.

We take client feedback into consideration when implementing changes or making decisions. Whether as a client or employee, we strive to ensure a secure and safe process from onboarding to offboarding.
